title: “The Prompters” at TEXIBITION 2K26
description: Participated in “The Prompters” at TEXIBITION 2K26, organized by Brainware University Tech Club and Institution’s Innovation Council. Contributed innovative prompting ideas, showcased enthusiasm for AI-driven creativity, and actively engaged in collaborative tech discussions and activities.

title: Google Ads Creative Certification
description: Certified by Google for expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing creative assets across Google Ads campaigns. Covers best practices for storytelling, mobile-first design, and interactive campaign creatives to maximize audience engagement and return on investment.

title: Google Analytics Certification
description: Certified by Google for comprehensive proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4). Validates advanced skills in tracking user engagement, setting up conversion events, building reports, and translating behavioral data into actionable marketing insights.

title: Class Representative Certificate
description: Selected and recognized as the Class Representative (CR) at Brainware University. Awarded for demonstrating outstanding leadership, student advocacy, conflict resolution, and facilitating effective communication between faculty and student body.
